rows.requirement: Offered by or with Income as the licensed insurer
rows.what: Every page footer and the onboarding say 'Underwritten by Income Insurance Limited (proposed)' and 'Concept prototype'. Sold as an add-on to Income's WIC.

rows.requirement: Triggers and pricing use independent, verifiable data
rows.what: Triggers read NEA WBGT, rain gauge and PSI from data.gov.sg; every call cached with URL and time; pricing from a back-test on the same data plus MSS records.

rows.requirement: Customer understands what they pay for and when they get paid in under a minute
rows.what: Onboarding shows plan, weekly price, GST, the may-not-pay sentence and a teach-back question; a timer shows elapsed seconds.

rows.requirement: Collect only the personal data needed; AI decisions explainable
rows.what: Only UEN, WIC policy number, outdoor headcount, wage band, site addresses, PayNow (UEN) and one contact. No worker data. Every AI check outputs a reason.

rows.requirement: No new hardware for the core product
rows.what: Core product uses NEA's public stations. Site Match uses logs the main contractor already keeps.

rows.requirement: WIC compulsory for manual workers and non-manual earning S$2,600 or less
rows.what: Rehat needs an active WIC policy; headcount comes from the WIC declaration; lapsed WIC excludes the month.

rows.requirement: Heat-stress rest: WBGT 32+ 10 min/h, 33+ 15 min/h; paid working time; hourly monitoring
rows.source: MOM heat stress framework and FAQs
rows.what: Heat tiers mirror MOM (plus a 5 min near-miss tier at 31.5); hourly mean of four NEA readings; worker notices state the rule.

rows.requirement: Four measures mandatory from 1 Dec 2026: heat-stress training, cool water, cooling supplies, suitable clothing
rows.what: Listed for employers at renewal; renewal reward for compliance (concept).

rows.requirement: Declared salary owed on idle days
rows.what: Basis of insurable interest for rain and haze hours.
Haze tiers on NEA 24-hour PSI at 12:00; PSI chips on the live map.

rows.source: MAS Guidelines on Fair Dealing (revised May 2024)
rows.what: May-not-pay sentence shown verbatim before purchase; teach-back answer recorded with explanation; plain-language receipts.
Price uses plan, benefit and headcount only; every AI check gives a reason; humans review flags; model cards; explainer cannot change numbers.

rows.source: MAS Guidelines on Environmental Risk Management for Insurers (2020) and transition addendum (Mar 2026)
rows.what: Back-test with stress cases, season view by ENSO, annual repricing from normals, climate assumptions disclosed.
Consent and purpose screen; workers opt in to notices by QR without personal data; delete at policy end.
Benefit (S$8) below the idle-hour cost (about S$10.20, assumption); only firms with declared outdoor workers; one policy per UEN.
Premium shown before and after GST everywhere it appears.
Receipt explains how to dispute; disputes are data checks; FIDReC link.
Roadmap only: riders via platform WIC.
Everything above uses existing rules.
Fewer than 3 of 4 readings is PENDING; fallback ladder; model estimate never pays alone.

rows.requirement: Forecasts never change payouts or prices
rows.what: Liquidity module is separate; a test checks payout code does not import it.
